newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues up, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues up, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks soared by a hefty 2.097 million barrels in the week ending March 12 to 12.692 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
This is the highest volume seen since early May 1996 when it hit 12.909 million barrels.
Middle-distillate stocks rose by a marginal 65,000 barrels to 6.777 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks fell by 454,000 barrels to 5.180 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
